The '''''Crucible''''' was a [[Jedi training cruiser/Legends|Jedi training cruiser]] owned by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] that was used in the centuries leading up to and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
[[File:JediCruiser-TG.png|thumb|left|220px|''Crucible'' docked at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant]]
[[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Huyang/Legends|Huyang]], the [[Architect droid/Legends|architect droid]] stationed on the ''Crucible'', stated that he survived on the ship for over a thousand years, dating himself and the ship back to the [[Old Republic era]]. The ship also had Old Republic markings to support this.

Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the ''Crucible'' was employed to transport a class of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]]&mdash;[[Petro/Legends|Petro]], [[Gungi/Legends|Gungi]], [[Katooni/Legends|Katooni]], [[Ganodi/Legends|Ganodi]], [[Byph/Legends|Byph]], and [[Zatt/Legends|Zatt]]&mdash;to [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], where they would undergo [[Gathering/Legends|The Gathering]] to claim their [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]].

After the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] found their crystals and they tried to make their own [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] on the ship, helped by Professor Huyang, the ship was [[Raid on the Crucible/Legends|attacked]] by [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirates]]. When [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and the Jedi younglings tried to use the ship to escape from the pirates on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], it was shot down and destroyed by one of the pirates' [[WLO-5 speeder tank/Legends|WLO-5 speeder tanks]]. Following the [[Invasion of Florrum/Legends|Second battle of Florrum]], [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and his pirates would later salvage the ''Crucible'' wreckage.
